name: Cloxacillin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Staphylococcal and other susceptible infections (adults, oral)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 250 to 500 mg every 6 hours, 1 to 2 hours before meals, for at least 5 days; maximum 6,000 mg/day

common: Nausea, vomiting, epigastric discomfort, flatulence, loose stools
serious: Severe skin reactions (acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, DRESS, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis)
Neurotoxicity in kidney failure with high levels

monitoring: Kidney, liver and blood counts in long courses

pk.bioavailability: Rapid but incomplete; food delays absorption
pk.half_life: About 25 minutes (infusion study); about 1.4 hours in an oral comparative bioavailability study (1.36 and 1.45 hours)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 37% of an oral dose (62% of an intravenous dose) in urine

sources.citation: JAMP Pharma Corporation. (2021). JAMP Cloxacillin (cloxacillin sodium) capsules 250 mg and 500 mg [Product monograph; prepared January 6, 2021]. Health Canada Drug Product Database.

revision_log.change: Oral half-life verified in the Health Canada PM comparative bioavailability table (1.36/1.45 h); kept.
